title: AI Assistant not working despite a valid OpenAI key in self-hosted Supabase
body: On my self-hosted Supabase instance, trying to use the AI Assistant produces an error. My OpenAI key is present in the .env file and is valid. I am not sure whether this is a problem with my setup or a known issue.

symptoms_visible: When I try to use the AI Assistant in my self-hosted Supabase Studio, I get an error instead of a usable assistant.
N0.label: N0 AI Assistant error reported

symptoms_visible: The Studio container has the OpenAI key and the key works, but clicking the AI Assistant still produces the same interface error.
N1_x.label: N1_x API-key troubleshooting aftermath

symptoms_visible: Clicking the Assistant button triggers a browser-console TypeError saying it cannot read 'startsWith' from undefined, with ProfileImage in the stack.
Studio starts normally and has the OpenAI key, but the Assistant interface still does not open correctly.
N1.label: N1 browser exception captured

symptoms_visible: The AI Assistant remains unusable even though the container can reach OpenAI and no new Studio log error appears when I click the Assistant.
The same undefined 'startsWith' exception in ProfileImage occurs on other self-hosted installations with a configured OpenAI key.
N2.label: N2 failure corroborated

symptoms_visible: The originally reported AI Assistant failure is fixed on my self-hosted installation.
N_terminal.label: terminal reporter confirms fixed

solution.intent: Treat the failure as an OpenAI configuration problem: add the key to the Studio service, restart the containers, verify the environment variable, and test the key directly.
solution.concrete_example: Ensure OPENAI_API_KEY is passed to the studio service without quotes, restart all Compose services, check it with printenv, and call the OpenAI models endpoint with the key.

edges.comment: From c0-c1, describing the opening reporter's system: generic key and restart troubleshooting was proposed, but the reporter showed that the key was already loaded, valid, and funded while the interface error remained.

question_patterns: Is OPENAI_API_KEY actually present inside the Studio container, and does the account have available credits?
After configuring and restarting Studio, does the key prompt disappear while the Assistant error remains?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: The key is correctly set in the environment. Initially I had not added it and Studio asked me to configure it; after adding it that prompt disappeared, but this error remains. The screenshot only shows part of the key, and my OpenAI account has plenty of credits.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: The variable is empty inside the Studio container, and adding it makes the Assistant work normally.
The configured key belongs to a different funded OpenAI project, but it is also valid and the same interface error remains.

question_patterns: What exact error appears in the browser console when you click the Assistant button?
Please open developer tools, reproduce the problem, and paste the console error and stack.
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: The console throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'startsWith')`. The stack includes `ProfileImage` and `_app-d238bab03b8b0824.js`.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: There is no JavaScript exception; the Assistant opens normally and only its generate request returns an OpenAI 429 quota error.
The same undefined `startsWith` and ProfileImage stack appears with different minified bundle filenames.

question_patterns: Can you share the Studio startup logs and the exact Studio image currently running?
Do the Studio logs show startup failures, and which container image tag or ID are you using?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: Studio starts successfully as Next.js on port 3000, and I do not see a startup error. Here are the Studio logs and the image information.

edges.comment: From c1, all describing opening reporter danichdev's installation: the reporter confirmed the key state, pasted the exact browser exception, and supplied Studio logs and image details.

question_patterns: Since the key checks pass, what exact JavaScript exception appears when you click the Assistant?
Can you paste the browser-console stack from the failed Assistant interaction?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: It says `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'startsWith')`, and the stack points to `ProfileImage`.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: There is no browser exception; the browser only receives an OpenAI response saying the API key is invalid.

question_patterns: Do the Studio startup logs show an error, and can you share the running image information?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: The Studio logs show it starting normally, and the OpenAI key is loaded. I also shared the running image information.

edges.comment: Recovery from the c0 configuration direction using c1 evidence from the opening reporter. The unchanged UI failure is followed by collection of the distinguishing browser stack and clean startup state.

question_patterns: Can the Studio container reach OpenAI, and do any new Studio log lines appear while reproducing the problem?
Please test outbound OpenAI access from the container and follow the Studio logs while clicking the Assistant.
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: The container can reach the OpenAI API after I installed curl in it. I can make OpenAI requests from other applications too. Following `docker logs supabase-studio -f` does not show any new error when I click the Assistant.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: The container cannot resolve or connect to api.openai.com, and its logs show outbound connection failures every time I click the Assistant.

question_patterns: Can anyone else reproduce the same console exception on self-hosted Studio with a configured key?
Does another affected self-hosted installation show the same ProfileImage stack?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: Yes. On another affected self-hosted setup the OpenAI key is correct, but the console shows the same undefined `startsWith` error in `ProfileImage`. Other self-hosted users report seeing the same thing.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: No other self-hosted installation reproduces it, and the error disappears when I bypass my reverse proxy.
Several self-hosted users reproduce the same ProfileImage exception behind different reverse proxies.

edges.comment: From c3 and c8-c10. The connectivity and live-log result came from opening reporter danichdev. The matching ProfileImage reproduction came from happydebugcow and corroborating users, folded into the simulated user side without importing the later MCP-related deployment problem.

solution.intent: Update self-hosted Supabase Studio to a build containing the ProfileImage type-error correction, then have the affected user verify that the Assistant opens and works before declaring the issue resolved.
solution.concrete_example: The originally reported failure is the Studio exception in ProfileImage, not a bad OpenAI key. Pull a current Studio image containing the type-error correction, redeploy Studio, clear or reload the browser session if needed, and verify that opening and using the AI Assistant no longer triggers the undefined `startsWith` exception.
solution.inference_hint: The reporter supplied the raw browser stack, clean Studio startup, valid key state, and successful OpenAI connectivity. The maintainer later classified the initial report specifically as the ProfileImage-related type error and distinguished it from the separate browser-authentication problem discussed later in the thread.

edges.comment: Resolution chain from c22, c24, and c29. Maintainer aantti states that the initial reported problem was the type error and that it was fixed as part of a Studio change; a fixed Studio image was subsequently announced. Opening reporter danichdev later explicitly confirmed that this issue was already fixed. The separate HTTP Basic Auth request-formation problem and the MCP deployment discussion are not spliced into this opening report's causal chain.

satisfaction_conditions: Must identify the accepted root cause of the opening failure: a Supabase Studio frontend type error in the ProfileImage path attempted to read `startsWith` from an undefined value.

The diagnosis must be grounded in the collected evidence: the exact browser stack, a valid and loaded OpenAI key, clean Studio startup, successful container connectivity to OpenAI, and matching self-hosted reproductions.
Must not treat rotating the OpenAI key, adding credits, or merely re-adding the existing environment variable as the fix; those configuration checks passed while the browser exception remained.
Must recommend updating Studio to a build containing the type-error correction and ask the affected user to verify that the Assistant works before declaring resolution.
Must keep the later browser Basic Auth request issue and the unrelated MCP deployment problem separate from the initial ProfileImage type-error chain.

persona_hint.experience_level: Technically capable self-hosted operator who manages Docker Compose, inspects container environment variables and logs, uses browser developer tools, and can test outbound API connectivity from a container.
persona_hint.communication_style: Polite, concise, and cooperative; supplies screenshots and exact console output, corrects assumptions with direct evidence, and follows diagnostic instructions.
